grid.layout_notes: 4-4-4-4-4; reel 5 locked in main until Scatter on reels 1–4. Conveyor Belt beneath bottom row. All reels unlocked in Tsunami/Submerged.

win_system.notes: Ways with stacked Wilds and Mr Split/Chainsaw splits.

expanding_reels.how_it_works: Scatter unlocks reel 5; Tsunami starts with bottom 2 rows underwater; Rubber Ducks raise water; full 4 rows → Submerged.

other.name: Conveyor Belt
other.how_it_works: Bottles (1–2 → Wild / Wild+split), Protein Powder Keg (partial→full stack), Benzo Bear (half: 3–8 random Wild/Scatter; full in Submerged: all below water → Wild), Mr SPLIT & Chainsaw.

other.name: Titan Spin / Idiot Spin
other.how_it_works: Submarine window: Presidant multipliers 15,000× / 25,000× / 57,000× or no win. Buyable as Idiot Spin 2,310×.

wilds.name: Wild
wilds.behavior: Any reel in main; from bottles/Benzo/full stacks.

wilds.name: Stacked Wild
wilds.behavior: Fully stacked characters convert to stacked Wilds.

scatters.name: Scatter
scatters.behavior: Any reel. 1 on reels 1–4 unlocks reel 5. 3/4/5 → Tsunami 12/15/20 spins.

specials.name: Mr SPLIT & Chainsaw
specials.behavior: Reel 5 when unlocked; splits row by size; Chainsaw +1 extra split on its reel. Fully stacked in FS splits all below water.

specials.name: Rubber Duck
specials.behavior: In FS: +2 spins each; raises Tsunami water one row.

specials.name: xGOD
specials.behavior: Can deliver max win instantly (portfolio feature).

base_game_loop.summary: Ways on 4-4-4-4-4 with reel 5 locked until Scatter. Conveyor modifiers (bottles, keg, Benzo, Mr Split). Asscar xBet +25% guarantees Scatter reel 1. 3/4/5 Scatter → Tsunami 12/15/20 (water rise → Submerged). Titan/Idiot Spin via submarine. Buys: Tsunami 68×, Submerged 258×, Lucky Draw 115.5×, Idiot 2,310×. Cap 57,000×.

phases.name: Spin + Conveyor
phases.what_happens: Unlock reel 5 if Scatter 1–4; apply conveyor features; evaluate ways; optional Titan Spin if submarine.

base_game_loop.win_evaluation: Ways after stacks/splits; Titan Spin is separate × bet award.

modes.name: Tsunami Spins
modes.retrigger: Rubber Duck → +2 spins and +1 water row.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: All reels active; starts with bottom 2 rows underwater; Mr Split fully stacked below water.
modes.progressive_state: Water level rises via Rubber Ducks; 4 rows covered → Submerged.
modes.end_condition: Spins done / upgrade to Submerged / Pearly Gates 57,000×.

phases.name: Enter Tsunami
phases.what_happens: Award 12/15/20; unlock all reels; water at 2 rows.

phases.name: Water rise
phases.what_happens: Rubber Ducks raise water; at 4 rows upgrade to Submerged.

modes.name: Submerged Spins
modes.trigger: Tsunami fills all 4 water rows (or buy).
modes.spins_awarded: Continues remaining Tsunami spins under full submersion.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: All 4 rows underwater; full Benzo converts all below water to Wild; Mr Split splits all below water.

features.name: Nolimit Bonus Buy
features.effects: Tsunami / Submerged / Lucky Draw / Idiot Spin.

ante_bet.effects: Asscar Mode +25%: guaranteed Scatter on reel 1.
